news.model_change: No model change. Endorsements are logged but not modelled.

news.model_change: Not used: a single report not confirmed by a major outlet. The model will change only if a ticket actually changes.

news.model_change: No model change. The model will change only if a candidate actually steps down or a ticket merges.

news.model_change: Set the 2027 tickets: Tinubu/Shettima (APC), Atiku/Amaechi (ADC), Obi/Kwankwaso (NDC), Makinde (APM), Onor (PDP).
